My top pick is the UGREEN Nexode 100W 4-Port GaN Charger. Based on the search results you provided, it offers the best balance of multiple USB-C ports, laptop-level power, and travel convenience.

Best travel chargers with multiple USB-C ports
Best overall

UGREEN Nexode 100W 4-Port GaN Charger

3 USB-C + 1 USB-A · 100W

Best for charging a laptop, phone, and two other devices from one outlet. Either of its first two USB-C ports can deliver up to 100W individually; with two USB-C devices connected, the power split is 65W + 30W.

A couple of important considerations:

Check shared power output. A 100W charger does not necessarily provide 100W to your laptop when other devices are connected.

Check your destination's plugs. These are wall chargers, not necessarily universal travel adapters. Outside North America, you may need a plug-shape adapter.

Count USB-C ports, not just total ports. If you want to charge three USB-C devices simultaneously, the UGREEN is the clearest match among these picks.

My verdict: I'd choose the UGREEN Nexode 100W for the greatest flexibility. If portability matters more than having four ports, I'd choose the Anker Prime 67W.
